name: trinity-desktop
description: Hand-rolled, hardened Electron desktop shell for Trinity. Serves the Angular www/ build over a custom privileged scheme (no Capacitor desktop bridge).
author: Trinity
//homepage: Required metadata, not decoration: the Linux `deb` target fails the whole build without it (fpm needs a package URL). It also becomes the NuGet projectUrl on Windows.

scripts.sign:dev: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') { console.log('sign:dev: skipped, not macOS'); process.exit(0); } require('node:child_process').execFileSync('codesign', ['--force','--deep','--sign','trinity-dev','node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
